checks.name: 1년 수익률 -10% 이하 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(du_er_1y AS DOUBLE) < -10

checks.name: 주식형 -5% 이하
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE zrin_btyp_nm ILIKE '%주식형%' AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) <> 0 AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) <= -5 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE) DESC, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 분배수익률 3~5% 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 총보수 0.5% 초과 상위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0.5 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 서열 2~4 회사채 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) BETWEEN 2 AND 4

checks.name: 순자산 1000억 이상 공모펀드 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fund_master WHERE TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) >= 100000000000

checks.name: 순자산 1000억 달러 이상 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) >= 100000000000 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 총보수 1% 초과 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 1

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 1등급 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND TRY_CAST(e.drv_risk_grade AS INT)=1 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 30

checks.name: 삼성전자 편입 2024년 이후 상장 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND replace(coalesce(e.pd_lstg_dt,''),'-','') >= '20240101' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO, ',', '') AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, c.etf_isin LIMIT 30

checks.name: Korea 지역 해외 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE wu_inv_rgn ILIKE '%Korea%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 상장중 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 순자산 1위 펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 서열 3 이하 회사채 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) <= 3
